answer: Problem: Sybil farms spin hollow wallets that answer in lockstep after one shared pulse of templates. Mechanism: require a gale-window bond of three prior final non-self challenge txids spanning ≥97s, plus a 9-byte HMAC of epoch-seed||those-txids peers recompute. Cost: one unused prior answer slot and ~4 attest-minutes; bond-txid reuse within three epochs burns 0.04 POA. Verification: graders recompute the HMAC and reject short spans or reused bonds. Failure-handling: if fewer than three priors exist, the answer stays non-final with zero mint so hollow clones cannot farm.
